from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import csv, hashlib, json, sqlite3, subprocess, sys
import numpy as np
import yaml
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

repo=Path("/home/server/liufengrong/robot_lab")
data_repo=Path("/home/server/liufengrong/sim2real_test")
root=data_repo/"experiments/wheel/20260924-170019-right-turn-instability"
run=repo/"learnings/policy_tuning/RobotLab-Isaac-Velocity-Flat-LW-wheel-Roa-v0/2026-09-23_17-23-24"
out=run/"evidence/analysis/hardware-rightturn-20260926-001"
assert not out.exists(), "Refuse to replace existing analysis evidence"

def sha(path):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open("rb") as f:
        for chunk in iter(lambda:f.read(1024*1024),b""): h.update(chunk)
    return h.hexdigest()

def ref(path):
    path=Path(path)
    return {"path":str(path),"sha256":sha(path)}

def git(path,*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git","-C",str(path),*args],text=True).strip()

checked=0
for line in (data_repo/"SHA256SUMS").read_text().splitlines():
    if not line.strip(): continue
    digest,rel=line.split(maxsplit=1)
    path=data_repo/rel.lstrip("*")
    assert sha(path)==digest, path
    checked+=1

z=np.load(root/"analysis/decoded.npz",allow_pickle=False)
names=z["names"].tolist()
with (root/"exports/joint_states.csv").open(newline="") as f:
    rows=list(csv.DictReader(f))
t=z["t"]; p=z["position"]; v=z["velocity"]; e=z["effort"]
channels=np.array([[float(row[name+"."+field]) for name in names for field in ["position","velocity","effort"]] for row in rows])
assert np.array_equal(channels.view(np.uint64),np.stack([p,v,e],axis=-1).reshape(len(t),78).view(np.uint64))
assert np.array_equal(np.array([int(row["bag_timestamp_ns"]) for row in rows]),z["bag_ns"])
assert np.array_equal(np.array([int(row["header_stamp_ns"]) for row in rows]),z["header_ns"])
assert np.array_equal(t,(z["header_ns"]-z["header_ns"][0])*1e-9)
assert np.isfinite(channels).all()
assert np.all(np.diff(z["header_ns"])>0)
with sqlite3.connect("file:"+str(root/"raw/lw_real_20260924-170019/lw_real_20260924-170019_0.db3")+"?mode=ro",uri=True) as db:
    integrity=db.execute("PRAGMA integrity_check").fetchone()[0]
    count=db.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM messages").fetchone()[0]
assert integrity=="ok" and count==len(t)

quat=p[:,21:25]
quat=quat/np.linalg.norm(quat,axis=1)[:,None]
w,x,y,zz=quat.T
rpy=np.column_stack([
    np.arctan2(2*(w*x+y*zz),1-2*(x*x+y*y)),
    np.arcsin(np.clip(2*(w*y-zz*x),-1,1)),
    np.arctan2(2*(w*zz+x*y),1-2*(y*y+zz*zz))])*180/np.pi
assert np.max(np.abs(rpy-z["rpy"]))<1e-10
cmd=np.column_stack([p[:,25],v[:,25],e[:,25]])
gyro=np.column_stack([p[:,20],v[:,20],e[:,20]])
assert np.array_equal(cmd,z["cmd"])
assert np.array_equal(gyro,z["gyro"])

saved=repo/"logs/rsl_rl/LW_wheel_flat_roa/2026-09-23_17-23-24/params"
env=yaml.load((saved/"env.yaml").read_text(),Loader=yaml.BaseLoader)
deploy=yaml.safe_load((root/"context/policy/LW/robot_lab/wheel_loco/config.yaml").read_text())["LW/robot_lab/wheel_loco"]
scale=np.array(deploy["action_scale"]); default=np.array(deploy["default_dof_pos"])
assert float(env["actions"]["joint_pos"]["scale"])==scale[0]==0.25
assert float(env["actions"]["joint_vel"]["scale"])==scale[8]==1.0
target=p[:,10:20].copy();target[:,8:]=v[:,18:20]
a=(target-default)/scale
joint_order=[name.replace("_now","_joint") for name in names[:10]]
weights={name:float(val["weight"]) for name,val in env["rewards"].items() if isinstance(val,dict) and "weight" in val}
archived=json.loads((root/"analysis/metrics.json").read_text())
phase_keys=["policy_zero_command","forward","pre_turn","turn_early","onset_left","growth","post_exit"]
phase_results={}
peak_check=0.0
for key in phase_keys:
    old_key="policy_zero_command" if key=="policy_zero_command" else key
    val=archived[old_key]
    mask=(t>=val["time_start"]-1e-7)&(t<=val["time_end"]+1e-7)
    idx=np.flatnonzero(mask);ai=a[mask];vi=v[mask,:10]
    rate=np.mean(np.diff(ai,axis=0)**2,axis=0)
    smooth=np.mean(np.diff(ai,n=2,axis=0)**2,axis=0)
    vel2=np.mean(vi**2,axis=0)
    wr=rate*np.array([abs(weights["action_rate_legs_l2"])]*8+[abs(weights["action_rate_wheels_l2"])]*2)
    ws=smooth*np.array([abs(weights["action_smoothness_legs"])]*8+[abs(weights["action_smoothness_wheels"])]*2)
    def share(vals,inds):
        return float(vals[inds].sum()/vals.sum()) if vals.sum() else None
    costs={
        "action_rate_legs":float(wr[:8].sum()),
        "action_rate_wheels":float(wr[8:].sum()),
        "action_smoothness_legs":float(ws[:8].sum()),
        "action_smoothness_wheels":float(ws[8:].sum()),
        "hip_action_L1":float(abs(weights["penalize_hip_roll_action"])*np.mean(np.abs(ai[:,:2]).sum(axis=1))),
        "all_leg_velocity_current":float(abs(weights["joint_vel_l2"])*vel2[:8].sum()),
        "additional_hip_velocity_if_weight_minus_0_005":float(.005*vel2[:2].sum()),
        "additional_hip_velocity_if_weight_minus_0_01":float(.01*vel2[:2].sum())
    }
    res={
        "row_index_inclusive":[int(idx[0]),int(idx[-1])],
        "header_time_range_s":[float(t[idx[0]]),float(t[idx[-1]])],
        "sample_count":int(len(idx)),
        "policy_stage_inferred":key!="post_exit",
        "include_in_action_reward_analysis":key!="post_exit",
        "command_raw_abs_peak":np.max(np.abs(cmd[mask]),axis=0).tolist(),
        "hip_target_abs_peak_rad":np.max(np.abs(target[mask,:2]),axis=0).tolist(),
        "hip_actual_position_abs_peak_rad":np.max(np.abs(p[mask,:2]),axis=0).tolist(),
        "hip_actual_velocity_abs_peak_rad_s":np.max(np.abs(vi[:,:2]),axis=0).tolist(),
        "hip_motor_reported_effort_abs_peak_Nm":np.max(np.abs(e[mask,:2]),axis=0).tolist(),
        "hip_debug_PD_estimate_abs_peak_Nm":np.max(np.abs(e[mask,10:12]),axis=0).tolist(),
        "body_roll_pitch_rate_rms_rad_s":float(np.sqrt(np.mean(np.sum(gyro[mask,:2]**2,axis=1)))),
        "roll_pitch_min_max_deg":[rpy[mask,:2].min(axis=0).tolist(),rpy[mask,:2].max(axis=0).tolist()],
        "per_joint_actual_velocity_rms_rad_s":np.sqrt(vel2).tolist(),
        "per_joint_action_proxy_first_difference_sq_mean":rate.tolist(),
        "per_joint_action_proxy_second_difference_sq_mean":smooth.tolist(),
        "hips_share_leg_actual_velocity_sq":share(vel2[:8],[0,1]),
        "hips_share_leg_action_proxy_rate_sq":share(rate[:8],[0,1]),
        "hips_share_leg_action_proxy_smoothness_sq":share(smooth[:8],[0,1]),
        "hips_share_total_four_weighted_action_proxy_cost":share(wr+ws,[0,1]),
        "wheels_share_total_four_weighted_action_proxy_cost":share(wr+ws,[8,9]),
        "weighted_proxy_cost_magnitudes_before_dt_mean":costs,
        "weighted_proxy_step_cost_magnitudes_if_dt_0_02_mean":{name:val*.02 for name,val in costs.items()}
    }
    for new_key,old_key in [
        ("hip_target_abs_peak_rad","hip_target_abs_max_rad"),
        ("hip_actual_position_abs_peak_rad","hip_position_abs_max_rad"),
        ("hip_actual_velocity_abs_peak_rad_s","hip_velocity_abs_max_rad_s")]:
        if old_key in val:
            peak_check=max(peak_check,float(np.max(np.abs(np.array(res[new_key])-val[old_key]))))
    phase_results[key]=res
assert peak_check<1e-12

    root/"context/policy/LW/robot_lab/wheel_loco/policy.onnx",
    run/"evidence/export/deploy-20260924-001/policy.onnx",
    Path("/home/server/liufengrong/policy_storage/LW/wheel_loco/2026-09-23-17-23-24/policy.onnx")]

historical_path=run/"evidence/analysis/flat-roa-final-assess-20260924-001/metrics.json"
historical=json.loads(historical_path.read_text())
historical_diffs={}
for key,c in historical["comparisons"].items():
    if "vs 2026-09-21_20-20-10/" not in key: continue
    stage="standing_40_120s" if "nominal-" in key else "turn_steady_42_70s"
    s=c["change_percent"][stage]
    historical_diffs[key]={"stage":stage,"scenario_contract_equal":c["scenario_contract_equal"],

            "body_roll_pitch_angvel_rms_rad_s","hip_target_step_rms_rad",
            "hip_velocity_rms_rad_s","hip_velocity_band_5_25Hz_rms_rad_s",
            "tracking_yaw_rmse_rad_s","tracking_xy_rmse_m_s"]}}

    "steady_40_120s/body_roll_pitch_angular_velocity_rms_rad_s"]}

fig,axs=plt.subplots(6,1,figsize=(11,14),constrained_layout=True)
mask=(t>=56.5)&(t<=59.2)
ts=t[mask]
axs[0].plot(ts,cmd[mask,0],label="raw forward input")
axs[0].plot(ts,cmd[mask,2],label="raw yaw input")
axs[0].set_ylabel("Input (raw)")
for j,label,color in [(0,"Right","tab:blue"),(1,"Left","tab:orange")]:
    axs[1].plot(ts,target[mask,j],color=color,label=label+" target")
    axs[1].plot(ts,p[mask,j],color=color,linestyle="--",label=label+" feedback")
    axs[2].plot(ts,v[mask,j],color=color,label=label+" hip")
    axs[3].plot(ts,e[mask,j],color=color,label=label+" motor reported")
axs[1].set_ylabel("Hip position (rad)")
axs[2].set_ylabel("Hip velocity (rad/s)")
axs[3].set_ylabel("Reported torque (Nm)")
axs[4].plot(ts,rpy[mask,0],label="Roll")
axs[4].plot(ts,rpy[mask,1],label="Pitch")
axs[4].set_ylabel("Angle (deg)")
for ax in axs[:5]:
    ax.axvline(57.406400601,color="black",linestyle=":",linewidth=.9)
    ax.axvline(57.846429304,color="tab:red",linestyle=":",linewidth=.9)
    ax.axvline(58.166450000,color="gray",linestyle=":",linewidth=.9)
    ax.axvspan(58.546485789,59.2,color="gray",alpha=.15,label="After inferred GetDown")
    ax.grid(alpha=.2);ax.legend(loc="upper left",fontsize=8,ncol=3)
axs[4].set_xlabel("Seconds from first header timestamp")
phases=["forward","onset_left","growth"]; xp=np.arange(3);width=.22
for n,(field,label) in enumerate([
    ("hips_share_leg_action_proxy_rate_sq","First difference"),
    ("hips_share_leg_action_proxy_smoothness_sq","Second difference"),
    ("hips_share_leg_actual_velocity_sq","Actual velocity squared")]):
    values=[phase_results[k][field]*100 for k in phases]
    bars=axs[5].bar(xp+(n-1)*width,values,width,label=label)
    axs[5].bar_label(bars,labels=[f"{val:.1f}%" for val in values],fontsize=8,padding=3)
axs[5].set_xticks(xp,["Forward","Left hip onset","Growth before GetDown"])
axs[5].set_ylabel("Both hips / all 8 leg joints (%)")
axs[5].set_ylim(0,105);axs[5].legend(fontsize=8);axs[5].grid(axis="y",alpha=.2)
fig.suptitle("2026-09-24 hardware right-turn incident: measured trajectories and target-derived action proxies")
out.mkdir(parents=True)
fig.savefig(plot_path,dpi=150)
plt.close(fig)
